headline: Pizza Bakery, Paris Panini operator Popo Global secures ₹532 crore from Invus Group: SAM, Argus, TT&A advise
sum: Popo Global Private Limited has secured a ₹532 crore strategic investment from Invus Group (Artal Asia Pte. Ltd.).
detail: Popo Global Private Limited has secured a ₹532 crore strategic investment from Invus Group (Artal Asia Pte. Ltd.). Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co advised Popo Global and its Founders Nikhil Gupta and Abhijit Gupta on this transaction. The transaction was led by Navruz Vakil (Partner), Alena Nari Advani (Consultant), Daksh Hemnani (Senior Associate) and Vidhi Shah (Associate).
